lve_note: bounding volume / box volume; lower is better. Computed only over orders the method packed completely, since a smaller pack scores a flattering LVE and comparing across completion rates would reward giving up early.

methods.label: EP Hybrid
methods.description: Extreme-point heuristic completing the shared Phase 1+2 prefix.

methods.label: RL + ReRanker
methods.description: The same PPO policy as RL Full, but a learned re-ranker (CNN over the height map, the support-dependency graph and the remaining order) scores the full ~8,100-placement enumeration and hands the policy its best 256 -- where RL Full gets 256 drawn at random from a smaller enumeration. The policy itself is unchanged and was never retrained for this.

methods.label: RL Full
methods.description: Candidate-ranking PPO policy, trained on whole orders with a hard centre-of-mass stability gate.

methods.label: NEAT Hybrid
methods.description: Evolved (NEAT) scorer over the same candidate placements.

baseline.label: Phase 1+2
baseline.description: The deterministic pattern-planning prefix every engine starts from. It stops before the remainder-filling phase by design, so it is the shared starting point rather than a competing method.
